ops.text: ccx v0.96.1 vcs stack restack, git lane: on a conflict it creates its conflict workspace as a linked worktree inside the branch's own worktree (<worktree>/conflict-<branch>/), and after the files are resolved, ccx vcs stack continue refuses with '<worktree> has uncommitted work; no branches moved', because that untracked conflict directory is the only uncommitted thing. Running continue from inside the conflict workspace and again from the worktree both refuse. Workaround: add /conflict-*/ to the worktree's info/exclude, then continue rebased and pushed. Fix: put the conflict workspace outside the worktree, or leave it out of the dirty check.
